name: Opulent Rouge - Inspired by Baccarat Rouge 540 for Men and Women
description: Opulent Rouge, inspired by the luxurious Baccarat Rouge 540, redefines sophistication and allure. It opens with a warm and captivating blend of jasmine, saffron, and ambergris, creating an immediate sense of opulence. As it evolves, the fragrance reveals a heart of fir resin and cedarwood, giving it depth and strength. The base notes of sweet amber and rich woodiness add a smooth finish, leaving a truly unforgettable scent trail. Crafted with precision, Opulent Rouge boasts a 40-50% perfume oil concentration, ensuring an enduring fragrance experience. Whether for a grand evening or a casual day out, this unisex fragrance makes an impression that lasts. Features Top Notes: Jasmine, Saffron, Ambergris Heart Notes: Fir Resin, Cedarwood Base Notes: Amber, Woody Notes Longevity: 10-12 hours (Extremely Long-Lasting) Occasion: Ideal for special occasions, evening wear, and high-end events Why Choose Opulent Rouge? Inspired by the renowned Baccarat Rouge 540 40-50% perfume oil concentration ensures a high-quality, luxurious scent A captivating blend that appeals to both men and women Exclusively available at Scents by Aamir in Pakistan Materials & Care Content: Alcohol-based perfume with premium natural oils Care: Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight to preserve its rich fragrance Packaging: Delivered in a sleek, elegant glass bottle, perfect for display and travel
